svg.text: False positives of the naive test
Gain from extra effort over the reference design

Bumblebee scenario of the page: haplodiploid, Nf = Nm = 1,000 (Ne = 1,500), samples 1935/1955/1975/2025, 20/20/20/40 females, depth 10×/15×, α = 0.05. 1,000 replicates under selection per point; Monte Carlo SD about 1.5 points.

b, c: breeding numbers varied (Ne shown) with 1×, 2× and 5× the reference sample sizes. d: each option adds 60 individuals, doubles historical depth, or moves the same 100 individuals to the first and last dates;
s chosen so that the reference design has 55–67% power; 5,000 replicates under selection per point (SD of a difference about 1 point).
